title: Resource pattern-based role templates and synthetic scope matrix
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Objective: Define a role model for RBAC v2 that uses resource-pattern role templates and a matrix of 'synthetic' scopes to cover cross-resource operations, while providing clear audit hooks and SAML group->role mapping for SSO onboarding. Scope covers: resource hierarchy patterns (org/*, project/*, dataset/*), synthetic scopes (cross-tenant admin, read-only-aggregate), explicit deny semantics, role template parametrization, and runtime evaluation requirements (cache invalidation, resolved-role stamping for audit logs).

Design highlights and constraints:
- Role templates: parameterized templates that map to resource patterns. Example: "project-admin:{project_id}" expands to permissions over all resources under project/{project_id}. Templates keep role proliferation low while enabling least-privilege.
- Synthetic scopes: computed artifacts (not persisted as granted roles) used at evaluation time for actions that span resource boundaries (e.g., billing-aggregate, cross-org-read). These scopes are returned in the resolved_roles list in audit events so downstream tooling can attribute cross-scope actions.
- Permission matrix: canonical mapping of atomic actions (read:list, read:get, write:create, write:delete, admin:configure) to resource-pattern templates. Matrix is stored in service as a CSV-backed canonical file and surfaced in Console.
- Inheritance & precedence: child resources inherit granted permissions from parent templates unless an explicit deny exists. Explicit deny wins; denies are taggable and must include a justification string for audit.
- SAML/SSO mapping: IdP group -> role_template mappings are first-class; mapping supports attribute-based constraints (e.g., group A gets project-admin for projects matching regex) with validation UI in Console.
- Admin controls: breakglass tokens issueable by org-admins with TTL, rotation policy, and mandatory audit_comment on issuance. Emergency tokens write an immutable audit event and require post-mortem drift review.
- Audit logging: every auth decision emits a single enriched audit event with fields: timestamp, actor, actor_origin (SSO|API_KEY|SYSTEM), resolved_role_templates, synthetic_scopes, resource_pattern, action, decision (allow|deny), cache_hit (true|false), evaluation_trace_id. The event schema version is v1.3.

Trade-offs discussed:
- Parametrized templates reduce stored grants but complicate UI discoverability. We will provide a Console explorer and CLI preview to mitigate.
- Synthetic scopes avoid expanding grants (safer) but push more responsibility to the evaluator to compute transient scopes; requires performance testing (see perf notes below).

Link to artifacts: Confluence spec: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SEC/pages/123456789/Resource+Pattern+Role+Templates, Design sketch (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_example, GitHub draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/2765

2025-02-25 - Arjun Patel: Initial permission matrix CSV uploaded to Drive and linked in spec. Early perf concerns: evaluation of synthetic scopes increased auth latency by ~3-5ms in microbenchmarks. Plan: add caching of synthetic-scope computations keyed by (actor, resource-ancestry, action).

2025-03-03 - Security review (Lauren Morris): Requested explicit deny justification and retention policy for deny tags. Also asked for clearer SAML claim validation rules. Added 'security_review_required: true' to metadata.
2025-03-06 - UX (Diego Ramos): Console explorers wireframes reviewed. Requested additional filters for resolved synthetic scopes in audit UI. UX will deliver mocks by 2025-03-18.

2025-03-10 - Arjun Patel: Updated spec to include audit event schema v1.3 and evaluation_trace_id for end-to-end tracing. Started working on a migration path: legacy grants map to role templates via a compatibility table. Opened github draft PR #2765.
2025-03-10 - Maya Chen: Blocker noted for RBAC cache invalidation across multi-region Dedicated clusters. Raised dependency on ENG-129999 (region-aware-rbac-blueprint).
